description: Parameters needed to the corresponding task specification in eTaSL

from-force_control_task_lib-version-1.0..description:
Library force_control_task_lib version 1.0.3.
 Set to true to indicate that task specification comes from the library above. 
 Library description: Library with eTaSL task specifications for force control tasks for Crospi
Authors: Santiago Iregui (KU Leuven), Erwin Aertbeliën (KU Leuven), Federico Ulloa (KU Leuven)

file_path.description: File path of the corresponding task specification

parameters.description: List of parameters needed to define an instance of the task specification

FT_sensor_frame.description: Name of the robot frame (from the robot model) of the force/torque sensor. The measured wrench of the input channel is expressed in this frame, with its origin as reference point

task_frame.description: Name of the robot frame (from the robot model) that is controlled, e.g. the tool center point.

stiffness_F.description: Diagonal elements [N/m] of the translational stiffness, as [x,y,z] along the axes of the control frame, used as model of the force control: the velocity along each axis is K_force*(desired force - measured force)/K_F. Lower values make the robot faster and more compliant along that axis, higher values slower and stiffer. The compliant axes should have a low value so that the robot follows the object (e.g. the arc of a door) with a small force

stiffness_T.description: Diagonal elements [Nm/rad] of the rotational stiffness, as [x,y,z] around the axes of the control frame, used as model of the torque control: the angular velocity around each axis is K_torque*(0 - measured torque)/K_T, i.e. the robot rotates with the object (e.g. a door handle that turns) with a small torque. Lower values make the robot rotate faster for the same torque

torque_gain.description: Feedback gain [1/s] of the torque control constraints around x, y and z (inverse of their time constant)

max_time.description: Maximum duration [s] of the task: it finishes when this time has elapsed. 0 disables this monitor

force_gain.description: Feedback gain [1/s] of the force control constraints along x, y and z (inverse of their time constant)

max_door_angle.description: Angle in degrees that the door should be opened (limited by geometry)

wrench_input_channel.description: Name of the input channel (type wrench) from which the measured wrench of the force/torque sensor is read: the channel fed directly by the robot driver/simulator (name_expr_cartesian_wrench of the MuJoCo simulator) or the varname of an input handler that provides it. The wrench is the wrench exerted by the end effector on the environment
